name: url
label: VictoriaLogs URL
help:
The base URL that serves the VictoriaLogs querying API, **without** `/select/logsql`.

- Single-node: `http://<host>:9428`
- Cluster (vlselect): `http://<vlselect>:9471`
- Behind vmauth or VictoriaMetrics Cloud: the URL your proxy exposes for log queries

pattern.message: Enter a URL starting with http:// or https://

fields.name: apiToken
fields.label: Bearer token
fields.help: Sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` — for example a vmauth bearer token or a VictoriaMetrics Cloud access token with read access.

name: accountId
label: Account ID
help: Tenant account ID for multitenant VictoriaLogs, sent as the `AccountID` header. Leave empty for the default tenant.

name: projectId
label: Project ID
help: Tenant project ID for multitenant VictoriaLogs, sent as the `ProjectID` header. Leave empty for the default tenant.

name: ignoreCertificateErrors
label: Ignore certificate errors
help: Enable when connecting to an instance with a self-signed certificate.

name: indexK8sCollector
label: Kubernetes (log collector fields)
help: Kubernetes metadata added by log collectors: Vector (`kubernetes.pod_namespace`, `kubernetes.pod_name`), Fluent Bit (`kubernetes.namespace_name`, `kubernetes.pod_name`) and plain `namespace`/`pod` labels.

name: indexLookback
label: Indexing lookback
help: How far back to look for logs when discovering objects, as a LogsQL duration such as `30m`, `1h` or `6h`. Objects that haven't logged within this window aren't indexed. Longer windows find more objects but make indexing slower.

pattern.message: Use a duration such as 30m, 1h or 1d

name: defaultCluster
label: Default cluster name
help: Cluster to assume for logs without a cluster field (`k8s.cluster.name`, `cluster`). Set it when some or all of your logs lack a cluster field, so the same pod seen through different field conventions becomes one object and drilldowns resolve.
